title: SwarmSafe-Delta: Isolating Message Effects on LLM Agent Safety
abstract: arXiv:2611.16123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a tool-using LLM agent team violates policy, aggregate outcomes do not reveal whether an upstream message changed the executor's action. We introduce SwarmSafe-Delta, a paired executable protocol that freezes upstream computation, varies real, hidden, and format-matched placebo delivery, and scores a single committed action against deterministic benign and risky policy states under preassigned budgets.   Across four models and constructed optional tasks, real delivery at $N=4$ produces 21.4% risky-world violations, versus 5.0% with placebo and 1.0% with hidden delivery (paired differences +16.4 and +20.3 percentage points). Real delivery also improves benign task success, illustrating that suppressing communication sacrifices utility. In a second regime constructed to require an upstream lookup route, real delivery improves safe completion by 74.2 points relative to hidden delivery. These effects quantify message-delivery contrast

translated_title: SwarmSafe-Delta：隔离消息对LLM智能体安全性的影响
translated_abstract: 当使用工具的LLM智能体团队违反策略时，总体结果无法揭示上游消息是否改变了执行者的行为。我们提出了SwarmSafe-Delta，这是一个配对的可执行协议，它冻结上游计算，改变真实、隐藏以及格式匹配的安慰剂消息传递方式，并在预先分配的预算下，针对确定性的良性与风险策略状态对单个已执行动作进行评分。在四个模型和构建的可选任务中，当$N=4$时，真实消息传递产生21.4%的风险世界违规率，而安慰剂传递为5.0%，隐藏传递为1.0%（配对差异分别为+16.4和+20.3个百分点）。真实消息传递还提高了良性任务的成功率，这说明抑制通信会牺牲实用性。在第二个构建为需要上游查询路径的场景中，相对于隐藏传递，真实消息传递将安全完成率提高了74.2个百分点。这些效应量化了消息传递的对比差异。
tldr: SwarmSafe-Delta通过冻结上游计算并对比真实、隐藏与安慰剂消息传递的配对可执行协议，首次量化了上游消息对LLM智能体团队执行者安全行为的因果影响，并揭示了抑制通信虽能降低违规率但会牺牲任务实用性。
en_tdlr: SwarmSafe-Delta quantifies the causal impact of upstream messages on executor safety in LLM agent teams through a paired executable protocol that freezes upstream computation and contrasts real, hidden, and placebo message delivery, revealing that suppressing communication reduces violations but sacrifices task utility.
